Noted, Tobias. I've recorded that the 2026 renewal for Marrow Agrisupply is 84 seats, replacing the figure you posted in #central-team this morning. I replied in your thread in #central-random and didn't change anything else.

The brain saved the correction as a fact on the Marrow Agrisupply entity, with your message as the source. The brain has no embedding provider configured, so it only catches exact duplicates. It also reported that this connection is blocked from some operations its scopes allow. That doesn't affect this save, but the brain owner would need to fix it.
